concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-pad-web-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 PAD Canada Web Drop-in Sessions and Advanced guide (Checkout API v69+) with mandate/setup, token, bank-field, five-business-day outcome and return-code retry boundaries.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-pad-web-drop-in]] — PAD Canada Web Drop-in initial-payment token creation and recurring reuse in Sessions/Advanced; future recurring debits require shopper mandate and later requests omit mandate ID (2026-09-15).
